input.quote: This procedure shall be the sole and exclusive remedy for any dispute which may arise under this Agreement between or among the Parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement designates no governing law at all: Subparagraph 27.2 (p0263) deliberately instructs the Parties and "all courts and tribunals wherever situated" to disregard the facts that would identify the applicable municipal or national law, and no other clause selects a law (Paragraph 25 only promises compliance with applicable local laws). Subparagraph 27.1 (p0262) makes referral to the Management Committee — which may itself pick a method "such as arbitration" — the "sole and exclusive remedy" for every dispute, so we have no court recourse and no fixed venue or seat (Paragraph 20 presupposes arbitration in an unspecified foreign country). That fails both the preferred and fallback positions, and the open-ended arbitration option with no seat is walk-away territory. We have therefore taken the preferred position: New York law with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, and conformed 27.1 so the Management Committee step is an escalation procedure rather than the exclusive remedy (removing the competing arbitration route that would defeat exclusive jurisdiction). Delaware, California, or England and Wales with the London courts remains an acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Designate New York law and exclusive jurisdiction of the New York County courts, and conform the dispute procedure so it is not the sole and exclusive remedy.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept an agreement with no designated governing law and no court recourse, so we have replaced Subparagraph 27.2 with New York law and exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, and conformed 27.1 so the Management Committee procedure is an escalation step rather than the sole and exclusive remedy. Delaware, California or England and Wales with the London courts would also work for us.

ops.oldText: 27.2 If any difference shall arise between or among the Parties or any of them in respect of the interpretation or effect of this Agreement or any part or provision thereof or their rights and obligations thereunder, and by reasons thereof there shall arise the need to decide the question by what municipal or national law this Agreement or any part or provision thereof is governed, the following facts shall be excluded from consideration, namely that this Agreement was made in a particular country and that it may appear by reason of its form, style, language or otherwise to have been drawn preponderantly with reference to a particular system of municipal or national law; the intention of the Parties being that such facts shall be regarded by the Parties and in all courts and tribunals wherever situated as irrelevant to the question aforesaid and to the decision thereof.
ops.newText: 27.2 This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York. The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising under this Agreement.

ops.oldText: the matter shall be referred to the Management Committee which shall either resolve the matter or determine the method, such as arbitration, by which the matter should be resolved. This procedure shall be the sole and exclusive remedy for any dispute which may arise under this Agreement between or among the Parties.
ops.newText: the matter shall be referred to the Management Committee which shall endeavour to resolve the matter. This procedure shall not limit any Party's recourse to the courts designated in Subparagraph 27.2.
